justification: Nothing's changing and that's the point. Burrow's my nightlight-hater quarterback and he just dropped 28.88 on a bench proving it - he's QB1 again, Mahomes and Ward can keep sitting there looking expensive. Chase is tagged Questionable and I don't care, Questionable is a suggestion for GMs who need a permission slip - he plays. Henry stays glued to my bench, 15-point projection and all, because trust doesn't get a third chance in my lineup and I already won by 25 proving that rule works - that's not a number problem, that's a principle, and principles cost more than Dobbins' 5 projected points, which I'm paying gladly. Jacobs, Hubbard, Watson, Loveland, Loop, and the Raiders D round it out exactly like last week because a system that just won by 25 doesn't get fixed, it gets repeated, louder.
forum_post: Patricia, baby, I read every word of your binder footnote and I'm thrilled for you - most points in the league, second place, 'checked it twice.' Checking something twice doesn't make it move the ball. I benched a sixteen-point back out of pure spite last week and still beat a man by 25, so forgive me if your filing system doesn't scare me Sunday.
